title: Session lock and logout
intro: Use the sidebar bottom controls to lock the terminal, log out, or open Settings. Idle lock/logout follows Session security under Manage → General settings.

sections.title: Sidebar session controls
steps: Lock keeps your user but returns to the login screen.
Power logout ends the session and returns to open login.
sections.caption: Settings, lock, and logout on the sidebar.

sections.title: Lock terminal
sections.intro: Lock is for short breaks so only the same user can unlock.
steps: The login screen returns with a locked banner naming who locked it.
Enter the same user’s PIN or password to unlock.
sections.caption: System locked banner on login.

sections.title: Idle lock or logout
sections.intro: Session security is set by the admin under Manage → General settings and applies to every user and terminal. Until saved, the default is log out after 15 minutes idle.
steps: Ask an admin (Master, or a role with General settings) to open Manage → General settings → Session security.
They enable the idle timer, set minutes, and choose Lock or Logout, then save.
When the idle limit is hit, the POS locks or logs out and shows a toast. The same user who signs back in resumes after a logout.
sections.caption: Session security card under Manage → General settings.
